name: Andre
title: Co-Founder & Board Member
bio: Community organizer with 10+ years building neighborhood connections through soccer. PhD holder with expertise in community development and nonprofit governance.

name: Diego Moreno
title: Co-Founder & Board Member
bio: South Side resident and longtime community leader. Brings over 15 years of hands-on experience working in Chicago Communities, combining operational leadership with a deep commitment to youth development. As the architect behind multiple school-based and recreational programs, he excels at building sustainable systems that serve youth year round. With a track record of managing budgets, partnerships, and teams.

name: Julian da Silva
title: Co-Founder & Board Member
bio: Experienced in community programming and youth development. Focuses on creating inclusive spaces and sustainable community partnerships.

name: Jordan da Silva
title: Co-Founder & Board Member
bio: Dedicated to neighborhood empowerment and authentic community building. Brings operational expertise and commitment to neighbor-led programming.

name: Alex Alvizo
title: Community Director
bio: Born and raised on the South Side of Chicago. Passion for community. Engineer by trade. I leverage these qualities to help deliver a safe and fun environment for our players in the most efficient and refined way possible.

name: Marcos Beltran
title: Community Director
bio: Southside resident.  Video game and soccer fanatic.  With a background in education, youth development and professional growth I try to make the most out of our members to grow and better our communities.

name: Michael Wang
title: Community Director
bio: I only started playing soccer in my late teens but loved the team aspect of the game. Enjoy meeting new people and learning about backgrounds and building a community here in the suburbs that, in my opinion, lacked pickup options. Currently work in the data engineering space with a side hobby of selling/trading pokemon cards. I have two cats and moved to Illinois in 2022 when my wife started her residency here.

name: Nicole
title: Community Director
bio: Strategic leader directing women's programming and creating empowering community spaces for female soccer players.

name: Natalie
title: Community Director
bio: Dedicated community leader focused on building inclusive women's soccer programming and neighborhood connections.
